fields.description: Program Description 1) Training requirements: 1. Adapted to all the four Chinese language abilities used in Chinese teaching environment, including listening, speaking, reading and writing skills 2. Master some basic professional knowledge 3. Gradually adapt to the teaching methods and learning methods of the university 4. Have the ability to learn and think independently. 2) Program categories Chinese Class (long term): The long-term class (more than half a year) enrolls students twice a year, starting in March and September respectively, with different levels: primary, intermediate and advanced courses. The core courses include: reading and writing, listening and speaking, reading, intensive reading, scientific Chinese, and Chinese culture, etc. According to the applicants’ application and class placement interview results, several small classes will be organized for teaching. Each class will have listening, speaking, reading and writing courses to comprehensively develop students' four skills. Classes will run from Monday to Friday. Every week 22-30 class hours will be arranged. In addition, there will be special tutoringcourses for HSK. ※ During the epidemic, online Chinese language classes will be provided. After the outbreak, the registration fee will be waived for online students who continue to study offline. 3) Completion and further education Upon completion: Students who pass the required courses and obtain the required credits will be awarded the Certificate of Completion for Chinese Language Training issued by the Institute of International Education. Further education: Students who have completed all the teaching procedures prescribed in the training program and passed the undergraduate qualification examination can directly enter the undergraduate program of our university. Those who do not meet the eligibility criteria for completion or fail to pass the qualification examination for admission to the undergraduate program may continue to study in the language program until they pass.

fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents in time. * 1. Original highest education transcript Academic transcript in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization. * 2. Physical examination form for foreigners Please take it to hospital to have a checkup with all items, including personal information, photo, checking date, doctors' suggestion and signature. 3. Transfer certificate issued by the original school Transfer students within China need to provide. 4. Guardian authorization certificate (Only required by applicants under the age of 18) 5. Visa pages (scanned copies of all China visa pages and entry-exit records) * 6. Certificate of No criminal record * 7. Passport information page With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 8. Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant * 9. Original highest education certificate Should be translated to Chinese or English if needed (If you have not graduated, please provide a "Pre-graduation certificate") 10. Transcript issued by the original school Transfer students within China need to provide. 11. Certificate of creditworthiness Transfer students within China need to provide. The funding requirement shall be calculated according to the annual basic expenses (tuition, accommodation, living expenses, insurance, etc.) of the program. The total amount of credit on creditworthiness certificate per program shall be more than 39000 RMB. It is required to deposit the corresponding amount in its own account for at least 1 month. In case another person ’ s account is used, it is required to provide a certificate justifying the relationship between the applicant and the account owner. At the same time, the certificate should be notarized by local authorities and verified by a Chinese embassy or consulate abroad. Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Non-Chinese citizens, physically and mentally healthy, able to meet the normal study and life at school. 2. High school graduate with high school diploma or above. 3. Friendly towards China, law-abiding, and no criminal record. Others If both or one of the parents is a Chinese citizen and resides in a foreign country, and the applicant who wants to come to China as a foreign student for undergraduate study has foreign nationality by birth, then the applicant must have a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025). (Nine (9) months of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit seal stamps). If a Chinese citizen after emigrating abroad applies to come to China as a foreign student for undergraduate study, then they shall hold a valid foreign passport or certificate of nationality for more than 4 years, and a record of actual residence in a foreign country for more than 2 years within the last 4 years (as of April 30, 2025). (Nine (9) months of actual residence in a foreign country can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit seal stamps).
